prompts.clouds: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a custom transparent sprite atlas for a dark-fantasy matte-painted volcanic dragon arena. Exactly FOUR distinct isolated effect sprites in a regular 2x2 grid, one per quadrant, generous TRANSPARENT clearance all around every sprite. TRUE transparent RGBA background and soft partial alpha. No text, grid, border, scenery, dragon, rocks, watermark or frame. Suggest detail with broad painterly masses and lost edges; avoid photoreal sharp microtexture. Warm charcoal, desaturated umber, smoky plum-grey and restrained amber reflected underlight. These are separate new assets, not pieces cut from a scene. Four different broad volcanic storm-cloud banks, long irregular low silhouettes: top left a heavy billowing horizontal bank, top right broken stretched wind-sheared cloud; bottom left low layered dark hanging ashcloud, bottom right soft ragged dense thundercloud body. Mostly dark cool umber/purple grey, subtle russet underlight, never bright orange fire. Cloud edges softly dissolve to transparent, visible semiopaque dark centres. No mountains, no ground, no lightning, no rain. All four fit safely within own cells.
